newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania's reserve money 5.2 pct up in May.
newsitem.headline: Romania's reserve money 5.2 pct up in May.

text.p: The daily average of Romanian reserve money grew 5.2 percent to 7.37 trillion lei in May after April's 4.1 percent increase, central bank (BNR) data showed on Wednesday.
Reserve money, also known as the monetary base or high-powered money, includes cash in circulation and in vaults, and banks' minimum reserves.
The daily average of cash in circulation went up to 5.6 trillion lei in May from 5.3 trillion the previous month, while bank's minimum reserves rose 2.8 percent to 1.53 trillion.
Local bankers said the rise in banks' compulsory reserves reflected a liquid money market after several BNR moves to drain excess dollars from the market last month.
